mapper.update: UPDATE CT_ABS_PRO_FEE_INFO PFI SET PFI.FEE_AMOUNT=( CASE PFI.FEE_NAME WHEN 'SERVICE_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.SERVICE_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'HOSTING_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.HOSTING_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'MANAGEMENT_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.MANAGEMENT_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'UNDERWRITING_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.UNDERWRITING_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'RATING_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.RATING_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'EVALUATION_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.EVALUATION_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'LISTING_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.LISTING_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'LAWYER_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.LAWYER_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'ACCOUNTANT_FEE' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.ACCOUNTANT_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'OTHER' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.OTHER_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') WHEN 'VAT' THEN ( SELECT SUM(PC.TAX_FEE) FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_COLLECTION PC WHERE PC.PRODUCT_ID=PFI.SOURCE_KEY AND PC.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL') END ), PFI.CURRENCY_CODE= ( SELECT CAP.PRODUCT_CURRENCY_CODE FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP WHERE CAP.PRODUCT_ID=#{productId}), PFI.EXCHANGE_RATE= CASE WHEN ( SELECT CAP.PRODUCT_CURRENCY_CODE FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT CAP WHERE CAP.PRODUCT_ID=1)='CNY' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHERE PFI.SOURCE_KEY=#{productId} AND PFI.SOURCE_TYPE='ABS_PRODUCT' AND PFI.CALCULATE_FLAG='Y'
